# Proof fixtures (tests only)

Each directory holds a real UltraHonk (EVM target) `proof` and its `public_inputs` (8 x 32 bytes:
policy_commitment, amount, merchant_id_hash, nonce, recipient, epoch, prev_spend_commit,
new_spend_commit) for the current circuit, generated by `scripts/gen-fixtures.cjs` with nargo + bb and
checked with `bb verify` before being written. The forge tests run every case against the bb-generated
`HonkVerifier`.

Victim policy: merchant `fixture-merchant` with payee `0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890`,
cap 500 per payment, 500 per day, policy salt 987654321, spend salt 55555. Epoch 20747 (2026-10-21 UTC).

| Case | Amount | Nonce | Epoch | prev_spend_commit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | 300 | 1 | 20747 | 0 (first of the day) |
| `second` | 200 | 2 | 20747 | `base`'s new commitment (spent 300) |
| `parallel` | 300 | 3 | 20747 | 0 (built alongside `base`; stale once `base` lands) |
| `nextday` | 300 | 4 | 20748 | 0 |
| `attacker` | 300 | 1 | 20747 | 0, under the attacker's own policy (same merchant, payee `0x…dEaD`) |

Regenerate after any circuit change (also rewrites `src/LeashVerifier.sol`):

    ./scripts/gen-proof-fixture.sh    # from the repo root, or: pnpm gen:fixture
